title: refactor: trust enabled MCP tool discovery
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the managed-agent MCP tool-name allowlist
- Exposes every tool advertised by the enabled Pollinations MCP server
- Keeps MCP tool names namespaced to prevent collisions
- Updates runtime coverage for dynamically advertised tools

gist.headline: The tool gate opens
gist.blurb: Managed agents can now discover every tool their enabled Pollinations MCP server advertises. The names stay neatly namespaced, because tool collisions are a deeply unromantic way to spend an afternoon.
gist.summary: Removed the managed-agent MCP tool-name allowlist so agents now receive every dynamically advertised tool from their enabled Pollinations MCP server, with namespaced tool names preserved.
gist.impact: Developers can add and enable MCP tools without separately updating an agent-side allowlist, while namespacing keeps tools from stepping on each other.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny explorer goggles, opens a cozy garden gate labeled "MCP TOOLS" as many distinct, neatly labeled code-tool sprouts grow from pots beyond it. A helpful CRT monitor robot holds a namespace map, showing that every new tool has its own tidy path rather than colliding in the garden.
